description: This file defines the Theme entity class for the OrangeHRM system, including its properties, constants for image validation, and getter/setter methods. It maps to the 'ohrm_theme' database table and is part of the Doctrine ORM entities.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Doctrine entity class representing a theme in the OrangeHRM system, including properties for logos and banners, and their associated getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the theme.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the theme.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the theme.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the theme.

methods.name: getVariables
methods.description: Retrieves the variables associated with the theme.

methods.name: setVariables
methods.description: Sets the variables for the theme.
